1. Uncorrected rater (Y^i(0)\hat{Y}_{i}^{(0)})
Under-rates computation & late steps
e.g., correct arithmetic step ↦\mapsto ×\times (true ✓)

2. Bias diagnosis + DSL
Biases (δ^𝒟\hat{\delta}_{\mathcal{D}}, δ^𝒟,c\hat{\delta}_{\mathcal{D},c}, pos. rr) & DSL μ^i,Y~i\hat{\mu}_{i},\widetilde{Y}_{i}

Pre-check (𝒟\mathcal{D}): |δ^𝒟|>2​SE,>2|\hat{\delta}_{\mathcal{D}}|{>}2\,\mathrm{SE},\,{>}2pp?
if no, fail →\to skip (keep Y^(0)\hat{Y}^{(0)})

3. Calibration prompt
Appends diagnosed bias as text

4. Content re-rating (Y^i(1)\hat{Y}_{i}^{(1)})
Flips false alarm (×\times→{\to}✓), catches true errors

Post-check (fresh 𝒱\mathcal{V}): |δ^𝒱(1)|<|δ^𝒱(0)||\hat{\delta}_{\mathcal{V}}^{(1)}|{<}|\hat{\delta}_{\mathcal{V}}^{(0)}|?
if yes, pass →\to keep Y^(1)\hat{Y}^{(1)}; if no, fail →\to revert Y^(0)\hat{Y}^{(0)}
